newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - April 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - April 18.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following items on its front page on April 18:

WASHINGTON - House Speaker Newt Gingrich said he will pay the $300,000 penalty the House of Representatives levied against him for violating ethics rules with a loan from former presidential candidate Bob Dole.
WASHINGTON - House Speaker Newt Gingrich has restored his grip on the speakership but still faces a long and uncertain road to political rehabilitation.
WASHINGTON - President Clinton approved a broad reorganisation of the State Department and three other foreign affairs agencies.
WASHINGTON - The District's human services agency has spent more money from a federal victims assistance programme on staff salaries than on helping victims of violent crime.
WASHINGTON - Fossils unearthed from ancient rock in Uganda have revealed the oldest known common ancestor of both men and apes.
WASHINGTON - A 15-month old girl died in a Beltsville, Maryland house fire after her desperate parents, passersby and firefighters tried to battle their way through choking smoke and heat.
HONG KONG - Hundreds of illegal immigrant children have been flooding over the border into Hong Kong from southern China in record numbers in recent weeks.
